attempts.summary: On node1 (Alpine Linux 3.23), created the `appworker` local account and enforced login-session resource limits of 8,192 open files and 256 processes via PAM (/etc/security/limits.d), since the default Alpine login stack (busybox su/login/sshd) has no PAM wiring. Verified the limits apply on both a real `su -l` session and a genuine network SSH login. Restarted node1 and reconfirmed the account, limits, and PAM-enabled sshd all survived the restart.
